declarations.description:
Animated connector between two elements: a line from one box to the other, with a light that travels along it.
Use it for data-flow and integration diagrams, where icons or cards are laid out with ordinary CSS and the beams
show how they connect.

Put the beam inside the positioned container that holds both elements (`position: relative`); it covers that
container and lets the pointer through. `from` and `to` name the two elements by `id`, looked up in the same
document or shadow root. The line runs from edge to edge of the two boxes, so it never crosses their content.

The beam redraws when the container or either element changes size. Call `redraw()` after moving an element
without resizing anything. When the reader asks for reduced motion only the line is drawn.
declarations.name: Beam

cssProperties.description: Colour of the light near the `from` element.
cssProperties.name: --c2-beam__beam--color-from

cssProperties.description: Colour of the light near the `to` element.
cssProperties.name: --c2-beam__beam--color-to

cssProperties.description: Length of the light as a share of the line, from 0 to 100.
cssProperties.name: --c2-beam__beam--length

cssProperties.description: Time the light takes to travel the line once.
cssProperties.name: --c2-beam__beam--duration

cssProperties.description: Delay before the light starts; a negative value starts it partway along.
cssProperties.name: --c2-beam__beam--delay

cssProperties.description: Stacking level of the connector in its container.
cssProperties.name: --c2-beam--z-index

cssParts.description: The resting line between the two elements.
cssParts.name: track

cssParts.description: The light that travels along the line.
cssParts.name: beam

members.name: from
members.description: `id` of the element the beam starts from.

members.name: to
members.description: `id` of the element the beam ends at.

members.name: curvature
members.description:
Bend of the line in pixels: how far its middle moves away from the straight line. Positive values bend it to the
left of the direction of travel (up for a beam running left to right), negative values to the right.

members.name: reverse
members.description: Sends the light from `to` back to `from`.

members.name: redraw
members.description: Measures both elements again and redraws the line on the next animation frame.
